name: Christ the King
kicker: Christ the King on Small Mountain
summary: Climb about 800 steps to the feet, then about 100 more to the shoulders, or take the motorbike taxi Vietnam Tourism names. Entry is free on that page. Dress as you would for a religious site. Skip it if the swim is the only reason you came, and do not photograph Mary on Big Mountain and call this the same statue.
timeNeeded: The climb. Minutes are check on arrival.
getThere: Steps from the headland, or a motorbike taxi from the beach.
heroCaption: Christ the King, both arms out, on Small Mountain

notice.title: Mary is the other white statue
notice.body: Our Lady of Mulberry Beach, on Big Mountain, is also printed at 32 metres. She holds a child. This figure stands on Small Mountain with both arms out.

body: The figure is 32 metres, dated 1974 on the Vietnam Tourism page, above where Back Beach meets Pineapple Beach. You climb about 800 steps to the feet and about 100 more to the shoulders for the view over the city. A motorbike taxi is the other way up that page names.

People stand on the arms. The frame you want keeps the head, the halo, and both hands. A crop that takes the torso and loses an arm is the wrong picture. The lighthouse is the early-twentieth-century tower on this same headland. Its gate hour did not load.

Go in the morning, before the heat. The pages warn about the climb. They do not print a gate hour. Dress as for a religious site. If a board at the steps asks for a fee, the Vietnam Tourism page still says entry is free, so read the board and decide there.

figures.caption: The head, the halo, and both arms, with people standing on the arms
figures.alt: Close view of Christ the King in Vung Tau, arms outstretched

gettingThere: Small Mountain is the southern headland. Vietnam Tourism puts the statue where Back Beach meets Pineapple Beach. From the beach, walk the steps or take a motorbike taxi. Minutes and the taxi fare are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Back Beach
legs.body: The steps start on the headland. About 800 to the feet and about 100 more to the shoulders, on the Vietnam Tourism page. A motorbike taxi is the alternative that page names. Minutes and the fare are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Front Beach
legs.body: The same southern hill. Ride minutes are not printed. Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly close is printed. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: Free on the Vietnam Tourism page. Dress as for a religious site. A second page with a different year or a different internal stair count did not load. Only this page’s 1974, 32 metres, and step counts are used.
